question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Ivanhoe, Bob gets Jane Eyre, Claire gets Persuasion, Dave gets The Trial, Eve gets Candide, Fred gets Siddhartha, and Gertrude gets Emma.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Fred and Alice swap books. Then, Claire and Dave swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Alice and Claire swap books. Then, Bob and Dave swap books. Then, Fred and Eve swap books. Finally, Claire and Fred swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Ivanhoe
(B) Jane Eyre
(C) Persuasion
(D) The Trial
(E) Candide
(F) Siddhartha
(G) Emma
solution:
Reader order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: Ivanhoe | Jane Eyre | Persuasion | The Trial | Candide | Siddhartha | Emma
1. Fred ↔ Alice: Siddhartha | Jane Eyre | Persuasion | The Trial | Candide | Ivanhoe | Emma
2. Claire ↔ Dave: Siddhartha | Jane Eyre | The Trial | Persuasion | Candide | Ivanhoe | Emma
3. Claire ↔ Bob: Siddhartha | The Trial | Jane Eyre | Persuasion | Candide | Ivanhoe | Emma
4. Alice ↔ Claire: Jane Eyre | The Trial | Siddhartha | Persuasion | Candide | Ivanhoe | Emma
5. Bob ↔ Dave: Jane Eyre | Persuasion | Siddhartha | The Trial | Candide | Ivanhoe | Emma
6. Fred ↔ Eve: Jane Eyre | Persuasion | Siddhartha | The Trial | Ivanhoe | Candide | Emma
7. Claire ↔ Fred: Jane Eyre | Persuasion | Candide | The Trial | Ivanhoe | Siddhartha | Emma
Bob has Persuasion, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
